# Open Reports

> Open Reports is an early-stage, MIT-licensed, self-hostable report designer and rendering engine. Teams can design printable reports in a browser, embed the designer, and render JSON report definitions through an API. The host application can retain ownership of report definitions, customer data, access control, and report selection.

Use Open Reports to evaluate browser-based authoring and rendering for invoices, receipts, statements, labels, and other data-driven documents. Output formats include PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, CSV, ZPL, and ESC/POS.

Open Reports is not a drop-in JasperReports or Crystal Reports replacement. It does not execute compiled `.jasper` files. JRXML import is partial: imported definitions are drafts that require review, and output parity is not guaranteed. Verify the current feature set and test representative reports before relying on it.
